scripts.build:main: bun build src/main.ts --target=node --format=cjs --external electron --external electron-updater --outfile dist/main.cjs && bun build src/preload.ts --target=node --format=cjs --external electron --outfile dist/preload.cjs
scripts.dev: bun run build:main && RUIMTE_DEV_URL=http://localhost:5173 bun scripts/launch.ts
scripts.smoke: bun run build:main && RUIMTE_DEV_URL=http://localhost:5173 RUIMTE_SMOKE=1 bun scripts/launch.ts
